routes: Same1m route guidance for methods without global planner; Chen keeps own planner and true goals.
parameter_policy: Pre-existing fixed defaults/selected references; no new tuning or per-case profile selection.
comparison: C1 first frozen point as a deployment policy; C1 finite64 Oracle upper envelope separately. Papers each have their own controller and run once per physical initial state.
errors: Known failed robot stops one step then calls normal algorithm; shared coordination errors without a single affected robot stop the joint step and are separately logged. First unhandled-error alternative from the same episode.
single_robot_check: All robots separately in state0 of every scene/profile; diagnostic only, not full four-state applicability certification. Failures retained and not called deadlock.
native_source_protection: Vendor/deps read-only; modifications restricted to versioned local adapters; native solver/control/dynamics ports explicitly documented.

root_fixes.Wang: Remove only port-added next-velocity speed SOC; retain paper acceleration/CBF constraints; common speed clip after QP.
root_fixes.Risk: Restore installed Clarabel default tolerances; no arbitrary solver relaxation.
root_fixes.DeadlockAware: Empty-cone semantics not assumed absent a paper justification; use common error recovery.
root_fixes.Chen: Retain occupancy-domain revision2; fixed400 termination-condition polls per original0.04 retry budget, source-defined retry scaling and fixed seed.
root_fixes.MerryGoRound: Full author circle/obstacle/CBF mechanism, native actuation endpoint mapped to common SI plant, arrival tolerance and true physical wall margins matched.

limitations: These are common-plant ports, not original paper experiments or native nonholonomic guarantees. Constructor failures/solo inability/solver errors prevent inferring intrinsic task difficulty from low success.
